# UAE Settlement (uaesettlement.com)

> Free calculators and plain-English guides for UAE end-of-service entitlements: end-of-service gratuity, unused annual leave, notice pay, pending salary and the full and final settlement. Mainland figures follow UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021 on the Regulation of Labour Relations; domestic workers are covered separately under Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022. Published by Servia Group (servia.ae). General information, not legal advice. Content last reviewed 2026-09-26.

Key facts (mainland UAE private sector, Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021):
- Gratuity (Article 51): 21 days' basic wage for each of the first five years of service, 30 days' basic wage for each additional year, pro rata for part years; requires at least one year of continuous service; total capped at two years' wage. Days of unpaid absence do not count as service.
- Resigning does not reduce gratuity under the 2021 law (the old unlimited-contract reductions no longer apply).
- All end-of-service dues must be paid within 14 days of the contract ending (Article 53).
- The calculators use a daily wage of basic monthly salary divided by 30.
- DIFC and ADGM have their own employment laws: DIFC replaced gratuity with the DEWS savings plan; ADGM keeps a similar 21/30-day gratuity under its Employment Regulations 2019. Most other free zones follow the federal formula.
- Claims under the federal labour law are not heard after two years from the end of employment (Article 54(9), as amended by Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2024). MOHRE decides claims of up to AED 50,000 itself.
- Domestic workers (Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022): the law contains no gratuity formula (Article 22 leaves the rules to the Cabinet); dues must be paid within 10 days of the contract ending; claims are time-barred 3 months after the work relationship ends.

## Calculators
- [UAE Final Settlement Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/): gratuity, unused leave, pending salary and notice pay minus documented deductions, in one figure.
- [UAE End of Service Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/end-of-service-calculator/): gratuity only, with the 21-day and 30-day bands and the two-year cap shown separately, plus a worked example.
- [UAE Leave Salary Calculator](https://uaesettlement.com/leave-salary-calculator/): accrued annual leave and its cash value at the end of service.

## Guides
- [Domestic Worker Gratuity in the UAE](https://uaesettlement.com/domestic-workers-gratuity/): maids, nannies and drivers under Federal Decree-Law No. 9 of 2022; what the law says about end-of-service pay, where the "14 days per year" figure comes from (the repealed Federal Law No. 10 of 2017), what is owed and how to claim through MOHRE.
- [UAE Gratuity Law Explained](https://uaesettlement.com/gratuity-law-2021/): the Article 51 formula, the cap, and what changed in 2022 for employees who resign.
- [UAE Full and Final Settlement Guide](https://uaesettlement.com/guide/): every component of a settlement, the 14-day deadline and what to do if you are underpaid.
- [Gratuity After 5 Years](https://uaesettlement.com/gratuity-after-5-years/): how the 30-day rate applies only to years beyond the fifth, with worked examples.
- [UAE Notice Period Pay](https://uaesettlement.com/notice-period/): notice periods of 30 to 90 days and pay in lieu of notice.
- [Unpaid Salary or Gratuity: MOHRE Complaint](https://uaesettlement.com/unpaid-salary-complaint/): how to file a labour complaint and what evidence to keep.
- [Arbitrary Dismissal Compensation](https://uaesettlement.com/arbitrary-dismissal-compensation/): what counts as arbitrary dismissal and compensation of up to three months' wage.
- [Limited vs Unlimited Contracts](https://uaesettlement.com/limited-vs-unlimited-contract/): why all mainland contracts are now fixed-term.
- [UAE Unemployment Insurance (ILOE)](https://uaesettlement.com/unemployment-insurance-iloe/): who must subscribe, premiums, and the benefit of 60% of basic salary for up to three months.
- [Dubai Gratuity](https://uaesettlement.com/dubai-gratuity/): mainland Dubai versus DIFC and free zones.
- [Free Zone Gratuity](https://uaesettlement.com/free-zone-gratuity/): most free zones follow the federal formula; DIFC (DEWS) and ADGM (own regulations) differ.
- [DIFC End of Service and DEWS](https://uaesettlement.com/difc-dews/): the DIFC Employee Workplace Savings plan that replaced gratuity in 2020.
